subject: Post-call: Novamed trial workload intake & operational plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Stevens <elliot@novamed.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Novamed trial workload intake & operational plan

Hi Elliot / Priya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Call highlights (short):
- Goal: 8-week trial to validate Redwood inference for Novamed’s clinical summarization pipeline and extract cost/latency targets for rollout.
- Primary success criteria: 95% of responses within SLO latency target and end-to-end quality thresholds for the clinical extract pipeline.

Workload hypothes_is / items we need you to confirm (see attached CSV stub: novamed_workload_matrix.csv):
1) RPS profile: baseline vs peak burst windows — we discussed average concurrent RPS and short bursts. Please confirm current estimates and any weekend/after-hours differences.
2) Token sizes: sample input token lengths and expected output token distribution (mean/max).
3) Concurrency: typical concurrent users and any mutexing or queueing in front of the model.
4) Burst patterns: how long bursts last (seconds/minutes) and expected frequency.

Proposed evaluation plan and timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize workload matrix and NDA tweaks if needed.
- Week 1: infra onboarding + sample payload ingestion + baseline perf probe (10–20k requests).
- Week 2–4: stress window (simulate bursts and real concurrency); iterate on batching/kv-cache settings.
- Week 5–6: quality assessment on held-out prompts; compare against your scoring rubric.
- Week 7–8: readout and handoff.

Ownership/contacts:
- Customer side: Elliot (technical lead), Priya (product).
- Redwood: Ben Carter (Customer Success / trial ops), Dev Patel (runtime engineer) — cc’d. I’ll run program management and weekly syncs.

Immediate asks for you (can reply inline):
- Confirm the workload numbers (avg RPS, peak RPS, concurrency, typical token lengths).
- Send 100 sample payloads (anonymized) or a Drive link so Dev can build realistic probes.
- Flag any compliance/retention constraints we should bake into the trial config.

I’ve attached a short Trial Statement (redwood_trial_statement.pdf) that outlines what we’ll provision during the trial and what we’ll measure. If that looks good I’ll schedule the Week 1 kickoff for next Tuesday (2026-06-16).

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Elliot Stevens <elliot@novamed.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novamed.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Novamed trial workload intake & operational plan

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the numbers from our side below (these are production-ish estimates; we’ll send a sanitized sample payload bundle later today).

Workload snapshot (current prod ingest):
- Average RPS (business hours): 8–12 rps
- Typical sustained concurrency: 25–40 concurrent requests (most are short-lived)
- Burst behavior: occasional bursts to ~150 rps lasting ~20–45 seconds; happens ~3–5x/day during peak clinic syncs
- Token lengths: input average ~220 tokens, 95th percentile ~900 tokens; output (summary) average ~120 tokens, max ~600 tokens
- Payloads: JSON objects with metadata headers; we will strip PHI and share 100 sample payloads by end of day.

Compliance note: we need audit logs for inference calls and a 30-day trace retention for the trial. Also want to validate that KV cache is isolated per-tenant.

We’re good with the proposed timeline. Tuesday kickoff works for Elliot & Priya. Please include Ben and Dev.

—Elliot
Elliot Stevens
Senior Engineering Manager | Novamed
elliot@novamed.com

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Novamed trial workload intake & operational plan

FW: Elliot confirmed workload numbers. Key bits for ops/infra below — please read and action.

Highlights to act on:
- Confirm trial footprint sizing to handle sustained 150 rps 45s bursts with P99 latency target <= 250ms. Model: open-model baseline (we’ll align final variant after run).
- Ensure per-tenant KV isolation; retention policy set to 30 days for the trial.
- Dev: build probe harness using the 100 sample payloads (HubSpot link + Drive link in thread). Start with a 10k probe, then progressive bursts to validate autoscaler.
- Ben: schedule weekly 30-min syncs (Tuesdays 09:30 PT) and record acceptance checklist items.

I’ve attached the Trial Statement for clarity. Proposed owners: Ben (trial ops), Dev (runtime + probes), Laura (security/compliance review).

If we can get an initial sizing decision by EOD Mon we’ll lock resources for next week.

Thanks — Jonas
